texts.preamble: Nimesh Agrawal vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 27 July, 2022 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur Order Sheet Cra No. 475 of 2022 Nimesh Agrawal Versus State of Chhattisgarh
texts.facts: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant was found guilty for the offence punishable under Section 52 of Chhattisgarh Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and he was punished with a fine of Rs. 1,00,000/- by the Additional District Magistrate and Adjudicating Officer which was challenged before Sessions Judge/ Appeal Tribunal (Food Safety Appeal Tribunal) and the same was confirmed.
